_comment: Pinned performance baselines (P4.5). Ratios against the calibration
loop in benches/engine.rs, not nanoseconds -- a hosted runner is not
the machine these were recorded on, and a ratio cancels that out.
Regenerate deliberately, never to make a red build green:
A number that moved because the work genuinely changed is worth
re-recording in the commit that changed it. A number that moved
because something got slower is what this file exists to catch.
